topic: What if gravity doubled every hour?

script.text: Here's how it works. At exactly seven, gravity got twice as strong. Everywhere on Earth. Every city, every ocean, every mountain, at the same second.
Nobody knows why. There was no flash, no sound. The Earth didn't get bigger. It's just pulling harder.
And it's not done. On the hour, every hour, it doubles. Two times normal at seven. Four times at eight. Eight times at nine. Sixteen times at ten.
You weigh what you weigh times that number. Your backpack too. Your dog too. The air above your head too.
Your mom steps on the bathroom scale. She looks at the number. She steps off, and never mentions it again.
Some things don't change. Light still works. Your phone still works. The TV still works, so at least you can watch everyone else panic.
So remember the rule. It only goes one way. Up. Double, double, double, every sixty minutes.
That's what everyone believes. Until ten o'clock.
